_doc: The six named stages every skill shares, plus Untrained (docs/design/skills.md section 3), in order, and every skill's ladder: the level each stage starts at (the numbers underneath; the defaults are 1, 3, 5, 8, 12, 17, tuned per skill) and the keys of its 'I can' statements in data/i18n/en.json. There is no top level: the levels go on past Master and the bar keeps filling. Words: skill_stages.<id>.name and .meaning. One table rather than a file per skill so the exe embeds one file and the website reads it in one fetch. sources: for a statement a dated review corrected or added, the source it rests on (its url and that source's own date); the review, with each source's quotation, is docs/reference/research/2026-11-14-skill-statement-review/README.md. Checked by tests/skills_data_lint.rs and crates/humanity-systems/src/skills/statement_review_tests.rs.
